semantic_segmentation: Automatic gray<=45 candidates in the initial-defined ROI, followed by explicit visible-ink polygon annotation. Broad metal/tool reflections, reflected cables, actual tool and permanent marks are non-ink. Identical interpretation before/after; annotations are retained for audit.
roi_definition: Disk dilation of the initial visible ink polygon by 6 native reference pixels, fixed before considering final ink. Not the nominal 65.30x25mm task strip; not the initial-mask intersection.
morphological_ink_cleanup: none; no erosion/opening or fragment-size deletion
illumination_correction: none; unchanged stable-background patches checked; reflection handling is explicit manual semantic annotation, not final-specific threshold changes
area_unit: initial-frame reference pixels (px); no mm2 calibration

alignment.home_method: identity after five stable surface-patch normalized correlation checks
alignment.alternative_method: SIFT on immutable plate features, Lowe ratio 0.75, RANSAC homography after-to-initial; target and moving robot/reflection regions masked

statistics: Arithmetic mean of evaluable per-run percentages; sample SD ddof=1; nulls excluded with n shown. No clipping or success threshold.
threshold_rationale: Fixed offline dark-ink threshold 45/255, used for every before/after. Selected to isolate the dense black marker from broad diffuse metal reflections, with explicit manual semantic labels. Not an independently calibrated ink classifier; sensitivity at 40 and 50 is reported.
